desc.shabao_ai.speechAddress: Defaults to MiMo (https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1, models mimo-v2.5-asr / mimo-v2.5-tts); any chat/completions-compatible speech endpoint works — ASR returns choices[0].message.content, TTS returns choices[0].message.audio.data as base64 WAV.
tooltip.shabao_ai.asrBase: Defaults to https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1; the endpoint's chat/completions must return choices[0].message.content.
tooltip.shabao_ai.asrModel: Defaults to mimo-v2.5-asr; set the model name for your endpoint.
tooltip.shabao_ai.asrKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
tooltip.shabao_ai.ttsBase: Defaults to https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1; the endpoint's chat/completions must return choices[0].message.audio.data as base64 WAV.
tooltip.shabao_ai.ttsModel: Defaults to mimo-v2.5-tts; set the model name for your endpoint.
tooltip.shabao_ai.ttsKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
tooltip.shabao_ai.ttsInstruction: Controls the tone/style of the synthesized speech.
desc.shabao_ai.roleIdentity: Change the AI's public name. Its core identity remains shabao, created by txcxgzs(ban).
tooltip.shabao_ai.companionName: The default name is shown as 沙包; a custom name is shown as CustomName(shabao). Existing conversations refresh the identity prompt on the next turn.
desc.shabao_ai.roleNameplate: Only custom names receive the (shabao) core identity suffix for multiplayer identification.
tooltip.shabao_ai.builtInSkin: Four skins are bundled with the mod and switch immediately after saving. Skin 2 is the default.
tooltip.shabao_ai.customSkinEnabled: Loads the local 64x64 PNG below. Disabled or invalid files use the selected bundled skin.
tooltip.shabao_ai.companionSkinPath: Relative paths start in .minecraft/config; absolute paths are supported. Replacing the file hot-reloads within one second.
tooltip.shabao_ai.affectionParticles: Hide the small heart effect without disabling hand-holding, hugs, or kisses.
